deviations.reason: Figma node 451:4629 'Vector' is the SVG path data of the static loading-spinner glyph (stroke #ffffff @ 1.5px). The impl renders the loading state via RN ActivityIndicator (native rotating spinner — same intent, different glyph), with a Vector wrapper View that has no border. App-wide loading-indicator system; the visible glyph difference is already documented via iconDeviations (the wrapper 451:4628). The wrapper's borderColor is a side-effect of the figma SVG stroke being modeled as borderTopColor; not an impl rendering choice. Approved 2026-05-28.
Same as above — figma's Vector node carries a 1.5px stroke that diff.mjs surfaces as borderWidth. Impl uses ActivityIndicator (no explicit border on its layout container). Approved 2026-05-28.

_iconWaiversRemovedNote: 2026-05-28 follow-up — back-button chevron (159:2), checkbox check (458:2), and 8 account-type-cards icon frames (456:3387/3395, 953:7898/8008, 456:3403/3416, 953:7982/8016) previously waived because the harness rendered bordered Views. Now they render real react-native-svg <Svg><Path/> components generated from Figma SVG export (svg-to-component → LoginLibIcons.tsx). _textMatchNote: Master frame is wide (2541px) with columns; text occurs many times (label '登录' repeats across 3+ cells). 80px center-distance keeps matches inside their owning button cell (≤350px wide) without crossing into siblings.
